pages.text: Dad's net lay in a big tangle in the yard. Dad had gone to repair the boat.
They wanted to untangle it all and surprise Dad. "His eyes will open wide when he returns!"
Riri picked up one loop. Lolo gripped the end of the net with both hands. "We must untangle it bit by bit." "Just pull it all at once."
Riri untangled one loop, then another. Only a handspan was free.
The sun sank slowly. A mountain of net still lay in front of Riri.
Lolo gave the net a sharp tug. The knots pulled tighter.
Lolo stamped and pulled. The net wrapped itself around Lolo.
While freeing Lolo, Riri found the end of a strand. "Here is the end!"
Riri held the strand's end while Lolo pulled gently. The net slowly came loose.
Dad entered the yard and opened his eyes wide. The net lay neatly spread out. Marks from the net were still on Lolo's face.
